ai_summary: ECI issues Voter ID (EPIC) to citizens 18+ via Form 6; free, online through NVSP.
ai_explanation: Any Indian citizen aged 18 can enrol in the electoral roll using Form 6 on NVSP. After BLO verification the name is added and an e-EPIC can be downloaded. The Voter ID also works as ID/address proof.
eligibility_summary: Indian citizen, 18+ years on qualifying date, ordinary resident of the constituency.
